What to look for: neither DXC pane finishes. Compiler Explorer answers
"Killed - processing time exceeded" instead of a diagnostic, on both the oldest
DXC it carries and on trunk. That is the reported hang, in a Release build.

  DXC 1.6.2112   killed, no output
  DXC trunk      killed, no output
  Clang trunk    compiles the same source

The shader stores nothing, so a compiler that gets through it is expected to emit
an empty entry point. The empty body is not the bug; not terminating is.

CE ships Release builds only. A Debug build of DXC does not hang here -- it stops
on an assert in SROA within seconds, and continuing past that assert reaches a
second assert whose message names the loop. Neither is visible on this page.
